jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing
locations: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re looking for an experienced Product Manager to evolve billing for enterprise growth. As a Product Manager, you’ll work closely with cross-functional partners on driving a roadmap of business-critical initiatives. You will be responsible for ensuring that Figma’s billing systems are scalable, flexible, and compliant, while unlocking growth for our largest customers. You will also have a chance to be part of a fast-growing company that is hungry for innovation and an incredibly talented Product Management team to learn from and partner with!

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States. 

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Partner with your cross-functional teams to define and build a reliable and flexible billing platform
  • Iterate on the core billing and payments infrastructure in partnership with Finance, Sales, Support, and Engineering, balancing business needs with long-term platform scalability
  • Partner with other Figma product teams to power new monetization efforts and unlock sales levers
  • Drive planning and prioritization, defining and tracking key metrics, and work closely with engineers to define feature functionality and execute against the roadmap

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience as a product manager
  • Previous experience with billing / commercial systems
  • Worked on products with a technical platform
  • A track record of leading complex product launches that require alignment across many teams
  • Excellent communication and analytical skills

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Have deep user empathy for both internal and external customers
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to adjust your approach for different audiences and rally a team behind a clear vision
  • Comfort working in a rapidly changing environment and adapting as priorities shift

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. 

Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off. Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave. PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.

Annual Base Salary Range:
$169,000—$303,000 USD

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities. 

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to: 

  • Holding interviews in an accessible location
  • Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
  • Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
  • Changing the mode or format of interviews 

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:

  • Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
  • Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.

Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Custody
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

Paxos is positioning itself as a connected platform to create, custody, distribute and utilize digital assets, and Custody is the control plane of those assets. The Custody product team owns the capabilities that let institutional customers hold, control, and move assets securely, and works hand in hand with Engineering, Compliance/Legal, Operations, and Go-To-Market teams to win tier-1 financial institutions globally.

About the role

Custody is where institutions decide whether they can trust Paxos with their assets. As Senior Product Manager, Custody, you’ll own the product that holds and secures those assets, including wallet management and the controls around how assets move, and set its direction as demand grows from crypto-native firms to banks, asset managers, and wealth platforms.

You’ll form a point of view on where institutional custody is heading and what Paxos needs to build to lead there, then drive it from strategy through launch. That means deciding where to invest to meet the security bar institutions require while staying flexible enough for how customers actually operate. You’ll work through technically deep problems with Engineering and learn directly from institutional clients what it takes for them to go live, turning their requirements into the product.

This is an individual contributor role with real ownership of a strategy that drives institutional adoption of our custody products.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Custody strategy and roadmap, and drive it through execution, from defining requirements to launch and iteration

  • Define the security and control capabilities institutional customers rely on to protect and govern their assets, including wallet management and the controls around how assets are held and moved

  • Drive the infrastructure and integrations that extend Custody to meet institutional requirements, including relationships with third-party providers and partners

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to deliver capabilities that are secure, usable, and meet the regulatory expectations of institutional clients

  • Work with Go-To-Market teams to drive adoption of new capabilities, from positioning and client onboarding to feedback that shapes what comes next

  • Engage directly with institutional customers and prospects, and turn their requirements into capabilities that serve the broader client base

  • About you

    • 6+ years of product management experience at a high-growth financial infrastructure company

    • Deep partnership with engineering teams on highly technical platform problems

    • A demonstrated ability to make effective product prioritization decisions with imperfect information

    • Demonstrated success getting buy-in from cross-functional teams, including senior and executive stakeholders, on your product vision and strategy in written and verbal forums

    • Experience building enterprise B2B products and working directly with clients and client-facing teams

    You might also have:

    • Experience with digital asset custody, wallet infrastructure, key management, or HSMs

    • Experience supporting large financial institutions including banks, asset managers, or wealth managers

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

  • Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers

  • We only use @paxos.com email addresses

  • We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

  • For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

jobs.title: Product Manager
locations: New York, New York, United States
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Peloton is looking for a skilled Product Manager to take ownership of our proprietary library management and content production software – tools essential for supporting Peloton’s core business of delivering fitness content and software features.


In this IC (Individual Contributor) role, you will lead projects that expand our content and product portfolio and will be responsible for ensuring software is easy to use in daily operations. The ideal candidate is a curious systems thinker who is comfortable challenging traditional workflows to achieve a better outcome, leveraging AI where possible. They will report to the Director of Product Management and work closely with members of the Content & Studio Production teams, other product managers and engineers to improve our programming and production capabilities and support the launch of new products and features.

YOUR DAILY IMPACT AT PELOTON

 

  • Collaborate with Content & Studio Production teams to modernize the software used for daily content production and library management and reimagine processes and SOPs for their use

  • Identify and implement opportunities to use AI/LLMs to reduce manual production overhead, improve quality and speed up content publishing

  • Partner with other Product Managers to think through and implement changes to our internal tools needed for new products and software features

  • Immerse yourself in Peloton’s programming and production processes and serve as the SME within the Product team

  • Generate detailed requirements documentation and process flows and socialize them with Product, Content, and Engineering

  • Support the rollout of changes to internal tools by supporting employee training and documentation

  • Work closely with Engineering to define requirements and designs, document tickets and perform user acceptance testing ahead of release

  • Develop deep relationships with the Content, Production, and Engineering teams

YOU BRING TO PELOTON

  • 2+ years of Product Management Experience

  • Experience working with internal tooling used for live production or content management

  • Experience with implementing AI to improve processes and workflows

  • Exceptional communication skills, especially the ability to work closely with experts in a different field to understand their needs and translate them into software changes

  • Strong UX sensibility and experience triaging and responding to user feedback

  • Experience working with an agile scrum engineering team

  • Highly collaborative and willing to give and accept constructive feedback

  • Self starter; ability to act autonomously

  • Constant attention to detail

BONUS

 

  • Experience working on a consumer software product with integrated hardware

  • Experience with ML-based recommendations and/or content curation tools

  • Experience in health and fitness, content streaming, or other related fields

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including H-1B transfers.

#LI-DD1
#LI-Hybrid

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position based at our New York City headquarters. The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors including, without limitation, experience and business objectives and if the location for the job changes. Our base salary is just one component of Peloton’s competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan as well as other region-specific health and welfare benefits.

As an organization, one of our top priorities is to maintain the health and wellbeing for our employees and their family. To achieve this goal, we offer robust and comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance 
  • Generous paid time off policy
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Access to mental health services
  • 401k, tuition reimbursement and student loan paydown plans
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Fertility and adoption support and up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave 
  • Child care and family care discounts
  • Free access to Peloton Digital App and apparel and product discounts
  • Commuter benefits and Citi Bike Discount
  • Pet insurance and so much more!
Base Salary Range
$140,400—$166,100 USD

 

ABOUT PELOTON:

Peloton (NASDAQ: PTON) provides Members with expert instruction, and world class content to create impactful and entertaining workout experiences for anyone, anywhere and at any stage in their fitness journey. At home, outdoors, traveling, or at the gym, Peloton brings together innovative hardware, distinctive software, and exclusive content. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City, Peloton has millions of Members across the US, UK, Canada, Germany, Australia, and Austria. For more information, visit www.onepeloton.com.

Peloton is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. Equal employment opportunity has been, and will continue to be, a fundamental principle at Peloton, where all team members, applicants, and other covered persons are considered on the basis of their personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic predisposition or carrier status, unemployment status, familial status, domestic violence, sexual violence or stalking victim status, caregiver status, or any other protected characteristic as established by applicable law. This policy of equal employment opportunity applies to all practices and procedures relating to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment.  If you would like to request any accommodations from application through to interview, please email: applicantaccommodations@onepeloton.com.

At Peloton, we embrace technology, including AI, to enhance productivity and accelerate innovation in the work we do for our members. However, in our hiring process, our priority remains in getting to know you and your unique qualifications. To ensure a fair and equitable process, we do not permit the use of AI tools during any stage of the application and interview process. In considering you as an applicant, we want to understand your skills, experiences, and motivations without mediation through an AI system. We also want to directly assess your communication skills without the use of an AI tool. 

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, as applicable to applicants applying for positions in these jurisdictions.

Please be aware that fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers may be circulated on the Internet in an attempt to obtain privileged information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Peloton does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted here on our careers page and all communications from the Peloton recruiting team and/or hiring managers will be from an @onepeloton.com email address. 

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Peloton, please email applicantaccommodations@onepeloton.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Peloton does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Agencies should not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Peloton employees or any other organization location. Peloton is not responsible for any agency fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Advisor Experience
locations: 61 West 23rd Street, Fifth Floor, New York, New York
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role

Betterment’s mission is to empower people to do what’s best for their money so that they can live better. As a Product Manager on our Betterment Advisor Solutions team, you’ll be responsible for executing against and helping to shape the product roadmap for a platform that allows registered investment advisors to efficiently manage their clients’ assets. You will be accountable for driving the next chapter of incredible growth in Betterment’s advisor business with expanded & improved workflows and tools.

You will be expected to navigate multiple concurrent projects from a high level and be able to also quickly dive into the weeds with engineers as needed to address technical, project-specific roadblocks. You’ll need to roll up your sleeves and work shoulder-to-shoulder with both highly technical and non-technical teams across the organization throughout the entire product development lifecycle. You’ll need to prioritize effectively in order to ensure that our Betterment Advisor Solutions team is building best-in-class solutions for our advisor clients. 

This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range we would offer for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees. 

  • New York City: $145,000 - $170,000

This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus.

A day in the life

  • Understand the workflows and business practices of investment advisors in our target market and serve as their advocate within the organization
  • Speak directly with advisor clients to explore ways that Betterment Advisor Solutions can continue to improve their practices and client relationships
  • Work collaboratively with multiple squads to create new capabilities to support (and delight!) our advisor clients
  • Ensure that the needs of our advisors are taken into consideration in the roadmaps of the platform teams who support our operations & money movement capabilities 
  • Partner with design and engineering leads to help shape the product requirements for new releases into our advisor toolset
  • Attend standups, planning meetings, and retros to support the Advisor Experience engineering team 
  • Coordinate with advisor-facing teams to navigate complex client situations and oversee successful rollouts
  • Regularly communicate project goals, milestones, and progress to business stakeholders and executive leadership
  • Use AI tools across your own workflow, from synthesizing advisor feedback and drafting requirements to prototyping ideas and analyzing data, so the team can make better decisions sooner and get value into advisors’ hands faster

What we’re looking for

  • 5-7 years of product management experience at a financial services or financial technology company with a focus on trading and/or portfolio management preferred
  • Strong analytical abilities with a passion for data-inspired decision making
  • Self-starter and demonstrated success at communicating, prioritizing, and balancing needs cross-functionally
  • Obsessive attention to detail and strong organization skills in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to build strong relationships across functions within an organization
  • Creative problem solving skills that balance complying with regulatory realities and a commitment to innovation 
  • Ability to think connect abstract or complicated back-end builds to delightful customer experiences
  • The story-telling capabilities that can help the organization see the long term vision of our advisor toolset
  • Experience shipping, or a strong point of view on shipping, AI-powered features, including how to evaluate output quality and manage risk

Join a team built on these core values

We change lives

Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.

We set audacious goals

We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.

We value all perspectives

When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.

We simplify financial services

We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.

 Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being:

  • We offer a competitive suite of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options
  • Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.
  • Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.
  • Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.
  • Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.

What happens next

We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.

In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.

On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of  applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process. 

We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!

Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter. 

Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Come join us! 

We’re an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, gender (including gender nonconformity and status as a transgender or transsexual individual), sexual orientation, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current or prospective service in the uniformed services, predisposing genetic characteristic, domestic violence victim status, arrest records, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Labs
locations: New York, New York, United States
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As a Senior Product Manager in AI Labs, you will be a founding member of this new team. You will lead a complex, fast-moving portfolio of zero-to-one AI products that impact our public sector partners and their communities. This is a rare opportunity to get in at the ground floor of something genuinely new: a dedicated space to move fast, experiment boldly, and build AI-powered products that could fundamentally change how cities operate. You'll have real autonomy, direct access to leadership, and the backing of a company that's already at scale - without the constraints that usually come with it. The role is one of thought leadership combined with a pragmatic eye towards building and shipping AI products for the public sector. If you're experienced at building AI products end-to-end and you're energized by the idea of doing that with a blank canvas, this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do:

  • Define AI Product Strategy: Lead the strategy for AI Labs, leveraging LLMs and agentic workflows to solve complex municipal challenges beyond traditional transit
  • Work Forward-Deployed: Partner directly with city leaders on-site to run scoping workshops, identify core problems, and iterate quickly on scalable AI solutions
  • Create Crisp Specs: Translate ambiguous requirements and user research into clear product specifications for intelligent tooling and real-time decision-making features
  • Own the Roadmap: Prioritize a fast-moving, varied roadmap using a data-informed framework to evaluate the ROI of new AI opportunities
  • Drive Execution: Act as the central liaison across cross-functional teams, steering day-to-day execution with Forward Deployed Engineers, Data Science, and Operations
  • Shape the Culture: Help establish the foundational product and technical culture of AI Labs, defining how we build, ship, and iterate from day one

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of PM experience at successful startups or global companies
  • AI expertise: Proven track record of identifying and shipping impactful AI-powered solutions (e.g., LLMs, predictive models, agentic workflows)
  • Zero-to-one builder: Demonstrated success owning end-to-end product lifecycles from a completely blank canvas
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You thrive in early-stage environments and take proactive ownership without needing perfectly defined requirements
  • Technical translator: Ability to synthesize customer feedback and technical AI constraints into a clear, compelling product vision
  • Customer-facing: Comfortable traveling to collaborate directly on-site with users, city leaders, and external stakeholders
  • Domain passion: A strong interest in the public sector, smart cities, and accessibility (direct working experience in these areas is a huge plus)

What We Offer:

  • Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable
  • Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans
  • Salary Range: $160,000 - $220,000
  • A 401(k) with company match and vesting
  • Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options
  • Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks)
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually

There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Product Manager, ChatGPT Business Growth
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The ChatGPT Business Growth team helps businesses discover ChatGPT, bring their teams on board, and make AI part of their everyday work. We build experiences that help owners, admins, and members get lasting value from ChatGPT, from creating a Business workspace to sharing useful work, building habits, and expanding adoption across a team.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Manager to own a meaningful area of growth for ChatGPT’s self-serve Business offering. You’ll set the strategy, define the roadmap, and work closely with engineering, design, data science, and go-to-market partners to turn customer needs into products that drive measurable growth.

Depending on the charter, your work may focus on helping businesses choose and start with ChatGPT, bringing more teammates into a workspace, deepening adoption and retention, or reaching small businesses through useful workflows and distribution partners. Across these areas, the goal is the same: help more teams get value from AI and build a durable business around that value.

This is an individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership of a defined growth outcome. You’ll combine product judgment, customer insight, and rigorous experimentation to decide what to build, align teams around the opportunity, and take ideas from early tests to scaled experiences.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA Or New York, NYC. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and results for your growth area, translating an ambitious goal into clear priorities and a practical plan.

  • Understand the needs of business owners, admins, and members through customer conversations, product data, and close partnership with design and go-to-market teams.

  • Build and improve experiences that help businesses get started, invite colleagues, adopt useful workflows, and keep finding value in ChatGPT.

  • Identify new growth opportunities, including tailored experiences and distribution paths that help small businesses adopt ChatGPT.

  • Define success metrics and design experiments that distinguish incremental growth from activity that would have happened anyway. Use what you learn to scale, iterate, or stop an approach.

  • Lead execution with engineering, design, and data science, making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, customer experience, and long-term impact.

  • Align with core product, monetization, marketing, sales, and partnerships teams on shared goals and dependencies. Drive outcomes across surfaces and capabilities that span team boundaries.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 6+ years of product management experience, including a track record of delivering measurable growth for self-serve SaaS, business, or team-based products.

  • Have owned a meaningful growth problem from strategy through launch and iteration, with depth in acquisition, activation, expansion, retention, or product-led distribution.

  • Are highly analytical and fluent in experimentation, with the judgment to connect funnel and cohort metrics to real customer value.

  • Have strong product sense and empathy for business users, and can turn a complex customer journey into a simple, useful experience.

  • Work effectively with technical and nontechnical partners, communicate clearly, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity, move quickly, and stay hands-on as you learn what works and adapt your plans.

  • Are motivated by OpenAI’s mission and excited to help businesses use AI in their everyday work.

 

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Business Network
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

About Stripe 

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Business Network team is integral to Stripe’s Global Payments and Treasury Network, designed to allow businesses to discover and transact with one another seamlessly. Our goal is to create powerful network effects that supercharge the products and services that Stripe provides to millions of businesses. We are a dynamic team looking for innovative and passionate individuals to help shape the future of our offerings.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of the needs of businesses interacting on the network and identify critical pain points to address.
  • Drive the product development lifecycle by setting strategic priorities, outlining product requirements, and leading cross-functional teams in delivering impactful solutions for our users.
  • Collaborate with design, engineering, and other stakeholders to create user-centric product experiences that are simple yet powerful.
  • Represent the Business Network externally with partners, clients, and stakeholders to gather feedback and promote our initiatives.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and use data analytics to drive product decisions and optimizations.
  • Communicate product updates and vision effectively with Stripe’s leadership and broader organization to align efforts and increase visibility.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of Product Management experience
  • Computer Science background or equivalent technical experience 
  • Demonstrated experience of leading initiatives across large engineering organizations, spanning multiple teams to influence tech roadmap planning and execution
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, structuring ambiguous concepts clearly and from first principles
  • Thrive in a collaborative environment involving different functions, stakeholders, and subject matter experts
  • Deep empathy for users balancing autonomy and guidance in digital commerce experiences

Preferred requirements

  • Background in launching new products or features, particularly in a startup or early-stage environment.
  • Familiarity with complex technical systems and an ability to balance tactical and strategic considerations in a product roadmap. Experience building APIs or new integration experiences for users
  • Experience in building or operating systems that involve user identity, payments, or financial transactions.
  • You’ve founded a business / startup, taking a product from 0-1

jobs.title: Product Manager, Financial Connections
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Financial Connections helps people securely share their financial data with the businesses they choose. Developers use it to build products that help people understand and manage their money. We’re expanding what’s possible with that data as AI creates new ways for people to interact with their finances, from making sense of everyday spending to getting personalized answers to financial questions.

We bring together Stripe’s financial infrastructure and developer ecosystem with Link, our consumer network, to help businesses build the next generation of financial products.

What you’ll do

You’ll build and grow Financial Connections’ next generation of financial data products, with a focus on AI-powered experiences. This is an opportunity to shape an emerging business at Stripe: identify the customer problems worth solving, turn early ideas into products, and build demand for them.

You’ll work directly with customers, from fintech companies to businesses building with AI, and own the journey from the first product conversations through launch and sustained adoption. You’ll have room to define the direction, experiment, and build, with Stripe’s infrastructure and customer relationships behind you. We’re looking for someone who is as excited to win an early customer as they are to shape a long-term product vision.

Responsibilities

  • Set the vision and strategy for new financial data products, identifying where Stripe can solve valuable customer problems and build a differentiated business.
  • Spend time with developers and customers to understand their needs, test ideas, and decide which opportunities to pursue.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design to turn ambiguous opportunities into simple, high-quality products, moving quickly while earning users’ trust.
  • Work directly with early customers to help them launch, learn what makes the product valuable, and use that feedback to improve it.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships to bring products to market and turn early customer successes into broader adoption.
  • Define success and use customer feedback, usage, and retention to decide where to invest, iterate, or change direction.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years of product management or product-focused founder experience
  • A track record of launching and growing new products for businesses, with ownership from customer discovery through adoption.
  • Strong product judgment and creativity, with the ability to turn an open-ended problem into a clear direction and make progress with incomplete information.
  • A hands-on approach to building a business. You’re comfortable pitching early customers, working through obstacles, and changing your approach as you learn.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineers on technical products, with a high bar for product quality and the ability to make complex experiences feel simple.
  • Strong analytical skills and clear written and verbal communication. You can use data and customer insights to make decisions and explain your reasoning.
  • Experience leading work across teams and external partners, with the autonomy, persistence, and attention to detail to see it through.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with financial products, data platforms, or products that use AI.
  • Experience building in an early-stage environment and scaling products within a larger organization.
  • Experience developing products that serve both businesses and their end users.

jobs.title: IT Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About IT

The IT team enables Affirmers to work securely and efficiently. We manage internal devices, networks, and systems, ensuring employees can collaborate and perform at their best. Our team supports onboarding, troubleshooting, and scaling technology across locations. We focus on usability, reliability, and security to maintain a productive work environment. The IT team ensures that Affirmers have the tools and support they need—wherever they work.

About the role

As an IT Product Manager, you'll help Affirmers embrace new ways of working and get more value from the technology they use every day. Partnering with IT leadership and teams across Affirm, you'll translate employee needs into product priorities, shape technology roadmaps and lifecycle decisions, and drive adoption of collaboration, productivity, and emerging AI-powered capabilities.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a collaborative, adaptable IT Product Manager to help Affirmers work more effectively by shaping how we manage, use, and adopt collaboration, productivity, and AI-powered workplace technologies.

  • You will partner with IT leadership to define and manage priorities for Affirm's collaboration and productivity tools, including Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, and emerging AI-powered technologies.
  • You will turn employee needs, business priorities, and technical constraints into clear requirements, practical solutions, and actionable roadmaps that guide technology improvements.
  • You will help guide the technology lifecycle, from evaluating new solutions and developing business cases to optimizing existing investments, supporting vendor renewals, and recommending when to consolidate or retire tools.
  • You will lead the rollout and adoption of new tools, features, and AI-powered capabilities, partnering with Internal Communications, business leaders, and employee champions to help Affirmers navigate change with confidence.
  • You will connect Affirmers with practical guidance, self-service resources, and learning opportunities—leveraging vendor expertise, existing materials, and on-demand options—to help them build confidence and get more value from workplace technology.
  • You will define success measures, use employee feedback, adoption data, and support trends to evaluate outcomes, and recommend improvements that enhance the employee experience and inform technology priorities.
  • You will partner with IT Engineering, Security, Legal, Procurement, and vendors to deliver solutions that balance employee needs, business value, technical feasibility, cost, and risk.

 

What We Look For

You bring hands-on technology experience, a product mindset, and a people-first approach to solving problems, collaborating across teams, and helping others embrace change.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience in IT product or program management, workplace technology, technology-focussed organizational change management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
  • You have experience identifying and delivering improvements to employee workflows through enterprise collaboration and productivity platforms, such as Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, or similar technologies, and are eager to apply that same approach to emerging AI capabilities.
  • You have experience gathering stakeholder needs, defining requirements, prioritizing opportunities, and developing actionable plans or roadmaps for technology solutions.
  • You have experience leading technology rollouts, organizational change initiatives, or employee adoption programs that help people confidently embrace new tools and ways of working.
  • You communicate clearly with different audiences and have experience identifying, organizing, and sharing resources that help employees understand and adopt workplace technologies.
  • You use data, employee feedback, and support trends to evaluate technology adoption, measure outcomes, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • You build effective relationships across technical and business teams, using sound judgment to balance competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and influence decisions without direct authority.

Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, which includes the annual base pay and the sales incentive target.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base salary range per year: $101,000 - 151,000

#LI-Remote

 

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Olo App
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As the Senior Product Manager for the Olo App, you'll own the consumer app that connects guests directly to the restaurant brands they love. Olo App is a multi-brand ordering app on iOS and Android, built on Olo's ordering, payments, and identity platform. Guests get one place to discover and order from Olo brands without any menu markups. Brands get a high-intent, high-conversion channel where they keep ownership of their guest data.

Working closely with Engineering, Design, and ultimately every function at Olo, you'll evolve the Olo App from its recent launch to become the obvious app of choice when guests get hungry. The Olo App follows Olo's brand-first principles: restaurants own their guest relationships, and the app earns every order through an excellent experience. Your relentless focus on measuring impact keeps each investment tied to guest conversion, brand adoption, and order growth.

You can work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. or at Olo's headquarters in NYC.

 

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Deliver on the vision and strategy for Olo App and Olo Network to increase restaurant supply and guest demand.

  • Build and maintain an outcome-focused roadmap using guest and brand insights, data analysis, business objectives, stakeholder input, and competitive research on consumer ordering apps and marketplaces.

  • Be the expert on both sides of the app: guests who order through it and restaurant brands who list on it. Know their personas, pain points, and the tradeoffs between them.

  • Own the guest funnel from download to repeat order: account creation and sign-in, brand and menu discovery, basket, checkout, and payment. Raise conversion and retention through prototypes, usability testing, and A/B tests.

  • Collaborate with our Strategy & Operations, Partnerships, Customer Experience, and Marketing teams to grow supply, including brand pipeline, onboarding throughput, and accurate live-location reporting.

  • Work with Customer Experience to deliver consumer-grade support, with fast resolution paths for guests.

  • Define and track the app's North Star and supporting metrics and use them to champion your investments across the company.

  • Translate requirements into specs with mobile, backend, and platform engineering squads.

  • Keep the app accessible (ADA) and compliant with App Store and Google Play requirements.

  • Promote the economic viability of the app by keeping vendor and operating costs within budget and gaining executive approval for large cost increases.

  • Diligently work to meet or exceed quarterly team-level goals, and manage up to secure the resources, time, and scope alignment your team needs.

What Will Set You Up For Success

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally with a consumer app or marketplace focus.

  • Track record of consistently delivering on your quarterly product objectives.

  • Hands-on experience improving consumer funnel metrics such as activation, conversion, and retention through experimentation.

  • Experience with enterprise restaurants is a strong plus.

  • Able to proactively manage your workload and tasks independently, demonstrating good judgment in prioritization and time management.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Your statements and questions are succinct and direct.

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher from an accredited institution anywhere, or equivalent practical experience.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to travel to customers, partners, conferences, and Olo HQ in NYC, as needed.

About Olo

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source, so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. Learn more at olo.com.
 
We’re remote-friendly. Since 2015, we have been evolving our culture to continue to support a more distributed workforce and now over 75% of our team works remotely across the U.S. If you're in the New York City area, you can choose to work remotely or from Olo's headquarters.
 
We offer great benefits, such as 20 days of paid time off, 10 sick days, 11 holidays, plus year-end closure, health, dental, and vision coverage for yourself and your family, a 401k match, remote-office stipend, a generous parental leave plan, volunteer time off, gift matching policy, and more!
 
Our best estimate of the compensation range for this opportunity is $176,000 - $200,000 annually, depending on the experience you bring and your location. This role is also eligible for incentive compensation. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.
 
We encourage you to apply!
 
At Olo, we believe bringing together people with varied experiences and viewpoints leads to better results. Don't check every box in the job description? Research shows many qualified candidates hold back from applying unless they meet all listed requirements. We're committed to creating a genuine workplace where everyone can contribute their best work—this improves our decision-making and helps us better serve our communities. If you're enthusiastic about this role but your background doesn't perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly the right fit for this or other positions.
 
All applicants receive consideration for employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 
 
California Residents: CCPA notice

jobs.title: Product Manager, Finance Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Financial Systems organization builds the technology that enables Stripe’s Finance org to operate accurately, efficiently, and at Stripe’s scale. We develop trusted data products, internal platforms and products, and intelligent workflows that help Finance teams manage complex global operations while maintaining strong controls.

This role will join a product team focused on transforming finance operations. You will initially work closely with Stripe’s tax and treasury organizations with opportunities for future impact in other parts of the Finance org. The products you build will help experts find trusted information, coordinate work, identify exceptions, and make timely decisions without stitching together context and workflows across multiple systems.

What you’ll do

You will develop products that will enable Stripe to maintain a continuously updated understanding of financial performance, automate complex operations while maintaining rigorous financial controls that minimize risk, and reduce toil for domain experts to free them for higher-value work. You will develop a deep understanding of expert users and their workflows, own the product strategy, turn it into a focused roadmap, and lead products from discovery through adoption and continuous improvement. The transformation your products enable will reduce risk, improve efficiency, automate manual tasks, and better enable Stripe to make timely financial decisions, deliver on regulatory commitments, and run a global-scale business.

This role combines internal product development, data platforms, automated workflow design, and applied AI. You will help develop purpose-built solutions, platforms, and autonomous agentic capabilities that reason over governed data, drive end-to-end workflows, and support expert decisions. Success requires understanding the capabilities and limitations of AI and machine learning when applied to business-critical, regulated, and strictly governed problems. You will also use AI-enabled tools throughout the product development lifecycle to accelerate discovery, prototyping, requirements development, evaluation, and iteration without compromising quality or controls.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of Finance users, jobs-to-be-done, compliance and regulatory considerations, and data dependencies, then translate that understanding into a clear roadmap for agentic automations.
  • Own products end to end, from problem discovery and strategy through delivery, adoption, measurement, and iteration
  • Build reusable data and self-serve workflow capabilities that eliminate manual overhead and enable future automated Finance use cases
  • Partner with Finance, engineering, data, security, legal, and others to make sound product and architecture tradeoffs in a business-critical and control-sensitive environment
  • Define measures to understand adoption, engagement, and impact for products and develop insights into the metrics to guide improvements to the product
  • Develop Finance products that enable Stripes to self-serve the creation and operation of agentic automations, while establishing appropriate boundaries for autonomous execution, evaluation methods, and controls for human review
  • Use AI-enabled tools throughout product development and help establish effective practices for AI-assisted discovery, prototyping, specification, testing, and iteration
  • Balance new product development with reliability, operational ownership, and the long-term health of the portfolio

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of product management or equivalent experience leading the development of complex software products
  • Experience independently taking a product from problem discovery through launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration
  • Experience working closely with engineering and data teams on systems involving data models, integrations, APIs, or complex operational workflows
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize the needs of multiple user groups and lead decisions across organizational boundaries
  • Ability to communicate clearly about product strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, risks, and results with both technical and nontechnical partners

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building products for tax, treasury, accounting, regulatory reporting, or other control-sensitive domains
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, workflow systems, internal tool development, or systems of record
  • Experience applying AI or automation to expert workflows while preserving human review, auditability, and accountability
  • Experience maturing a product from active development into a reliable, sustainable operating model

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Activation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

About Justworks 

Justworks is leveling the playing field for all small businesses. We handle the nitty-gritty of payroll, benefits, compliance, and HR, so our customers have more time to learn, grow, and seek something worthwhile. Today, Justworks offices in New York, Toronto, London, Tampa and Mexico City serve more than 12,000 businesses and 200,000 workers around the globe. 

Our mission is to help entrepreneurs and businesses grow with confidence. This means our customers are at the center of everything we do, and working at Justworks is an opportunity to obsess over creating and delivering value that helps millions achieve their dreams.

We’re united by shared goals and motivations, best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our products and our team.

About the team / Product at Justworks

The Justworks Product team advances our mission by building products that extend levels of personal care and deep expertise that our customers have never experienced before. They craft innovative solutions that guide users through the most complicated challenges of running (and working for) a small business, with ease. They deeply understand complex regulatory spaces like FinTech, Healthcare, and HRTech, and have a keen intuition for how to connect threads across our customers’ needs and our business’ risk management and commercialization strategy. Our Product Managers lead highly collaborative creative endeavors, bringing together stakeholders across engineering, design, data services, operations, and customer-facing teams to deliver tangible value.

By joining us, you’ll be part of an experienced team of Product Managers who have a proven track record of building large-scale software products that impact small businesses worldwide.

We’re looking for teammates who will help shape Justworks’ future and make a profound impact on our business. As a Product Manager, you’ll be working across complex spaces - Fintech, Healthcare, HR Tech - all with serious policy/regulatory environments that will require you to have a keen intuition for customer needs, risk management, and commercialization. Care is at the center of everything we do, and you’ll need to love talking with customers and engaging with our Customer Success, Sales and Marketing teams to make sure that care is coming through in every part of our customers’ experience. You’ll be joining a diverse community of craftspeople who are passionate about learning, uphold exceptionally high standards of quality, and foster an environment of strategic thinking where product people can reach new heights.

About the role 

The Activation team is a new pod within the Onboarding & Activation mission, sitting alongside our Company Onboarding and People Onboarding pods. While those pods focus on getting companies and their employees service-ready, the Activation pod’s goal is to get Justworks customers to that moment of value recognition as quickly and efficiently as possible. Comprised of Product, Engineering, Design, and Data, this pod will work cross-functionally with GTM, Ops, and other core product teams to drive activation across the customer lifecycle.

As a Senior Product Manager on the Activation team, you'll own the strategy, experimentation roadmap, and cross-functional execution to get customers to their first moment of value faster and turn initial setup into ongoing product adoption across core products like Payroll, PEO, EOR, and cross-product integrations and add-ons.

Responsibilities

  • Embrace complex platform and experience related stakeholder problems
  • Analyze funnel drop-offs, design and run experiments, work with research to interview customers, and partner with Data Science to define and track activation metrics
  • Demonstrate expertise in deploying a product strategy and effectively tie insights to roadmap outcomes
  • Scope, prioritize, and execute projects to deliver measurable business impact while ensuring clarity on objectives, leverage, and accountability for outcomes
  • Partner deeply with Design and Engineering peers and organize and lead effective team processes and routines
  • Demonstrate a rich understanding of engineering concepts, concerns and tradeoffs, and effectively communicate them to manage stakeholder expectations around deadlines and scope
  • Drive camaraderie with your team while demonstrating effective collaboration with PMs across other pods/teams

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years in product management, with 2+ years in product-led growth, self-serve activation, or onboarding
  • 0-to-1 product execution, including experience standing up a new pod, defining baseline metrics, and building a roadmap from scratch
  • Proven track record running A/B tests and shipping in-app flows -- checklists, nudges, guided setups -- that moved conversion, adoption, or time-to-value
  • Strong data background and comfortable digging into funnel and cohort data and partnering closely with Data Science
  • Excellent stakeholder management and ability to influence your working partners without authority
  • Interest in leveraging generative AI to alleviate daily tasks and expedite delivery while retaining critical thinking and knowledge on core concepts
  • Experience leading complex, cross-team initiatives from ideation to execution
  • Track record of shipping continuous product improvements to an existing product portfolio at-scale
  • Strong problem-solving skills, capable of breaking down complex problems for team execution against business needs
  • Deep user empathy and a high bar for user experience
  • Strong communication skills for effectively conveying product-related matters, including changes in scope or strategic direction

The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $166,000 - $242,500 per year.

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. 

For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks. 

Diversity At Justworks

Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at accommodations@justworks.com. Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience.
